definition: A text generation strategy that selects the single most probable next token at each step, without considering alternative sequences.
details: Greedy decoding is fast and deterministic but can lead to suboptimal overall sequences and repetitive text, since it never reconsiders earlier choices.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. Here is the short version: A text generation strategy that selects the single most probable next token at each step, without considering alternative sequences. The part that makes it sing: Greedy decoding is fast and deterministic but can lead to suboptimal overall sequences and repetitive text, since it never reconsiders earlier choices. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. And that is Greedy Decoding — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
